latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor CapCut — fast cloud-based video editing for TikTok creators.

- Upload raw video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe desired edits—no manual sliders required.
- Automated setup handles authentication and session management; ready to use in seconds.
- Supports actions like trimming clips, adding text overlays, syncing background music, and quick 1080p MP4 exports.
- Guides users with clear feedback and robust error handling (file size limits, format support, token issues, rate limits).
- Built-in workflows for quick editing, batch processing, and iterative refinement, optimized for social video formats.
